 Search for: Search ADVERTISEMENT E Entertainment GTA VI for PS5 Available on pandamart for $99 from November 18 with One-Hour Delivery
 GTA VI joins the pandamart shopping list by GDS Editorial Team 
 November 18, 2026
 Only 90 copies of GTA VI are up for grabs on pandamart from November 18 Follow us on WhatsApp Join our Telegram Channel Gamers in Singapore looking to get their hands on Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) have an unexpected place to shop for the highly anticipated title. Instead of heading to a gaming retailer, they can now turn to foodpanda’s pandamart to secure a copy.
 Starting 18 November 2026 at 7pm , pandamart will offer the Grand Theft Auto VI Standard Edition for PlayStation 5 (PS5) at $99 , giving players a $10 saving off its recommended retail price of $109.
 There’s a catch, though. Only 90 copies will be available across pandamart stores in Singapore , making this a particularly limited opportunity for fans hoping to pick up the game.
 ADVERTISEMENT Get GTA VI Delivered to Your Doorstep in an Hour
 While pandamart is usually associated with groceries, snacks and everyday essentials, its latest offering takes things in a rather different direction.
 Players can order GTA VI directly through the foodpanda app, with delivery available in as little as an hour. That means skipping the trip to a physical store and having the game brought straight to their doorstep.
 The $99 offer applies specifically to the PS5 Standard Edition, with purchases available from 7pm on 18 November.
 ADVERTISEMENT With just 90 copies up for grabs islandwide, stocks could run out quickly, especially given the anticipation surrounding the game.
 Enjoy $6 Off Food Orders and Up to 40% Off pandamart Deals
 To go along with the gaming release, foodpanda is also rolling out a series of promotions for those planning a gaming session at home.
 From now until 29 November 2026 , customers can enjoy $6 off selected orders using promo code LOBANG , covering eligible restaurant deliveries, pick-up orders, pandamart purchases and participating shops.
 ADVERTISEMENT The promotion includes popular food options such as:
 4Fingers Crispy Chicken
 Luckin’ Coffee
 Texas Chicken
 The Soup Spoon
 Other participating restaurants and merchants
 Whether it’s a fried chicken meal, a coffee break or snacks to keep within reach, the discount could come in handy for a longer gaming session.
 There are also up to 40% off selected pandamart deals , giving customers another opportunity to stock up on drinks, snacks and other essentials without making a separate shopping trip.
 Minimum spending requirements and eligibility conditions apply to the $6 discount.
 ADVERTISEMENT Additional Perks for New Customers and pandapro Subscribers
 Those who have yet to try foodpanda or pandamart can also make use of introductory offers.
 New foodpanda customers can apply the promo code NEWPANDA on their first order, while first-time pandamart grocery shoppers can use NEWGROCER .
 Meanwhile, pandapro subscribers can enjoy unlimited free delivery on eligible orders, subject to minimum spending requirements.
 The subscription is priced at $5.99 per month , with restaurant minimum spends varying according to distance and delivery location.
 ADVERTISEMENT GTA VI pandamart Offer Details
 Here’s a quick rundown of the limited release:
 Game: Grand Theft Auto VI Standard Edition (PS5)
 Price: $99 (U.P. $109)
 Available from: 18 November 2026, 7pm SGT
 Quantity: Limited to 90 copies across pandamart stores
 Ordering platform: foodpanda app, via pandamart
 Delivery: As little as one hour, subject to availability
 Additional promotion: $6 off selected orders with code LOBANG until 29 November 2026
 Other savings: Up to 40% off selected pandamart deals
 With only 90 copies available, those hoping to secure GTA VI through pandamart may want to have the foodpanda app ready when sales begin at 7pm.
 For more details and applicable terms and conditions, visit the foodpanda app or website.
 Note: This pandamart promotion is not associated with or sponsored by Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, GTA VI or Sony Interactive Entertainment. All offers are subject to availability, eligibility and other applicable terms and conditions.
